slides.say: For every two numbers x and y, diamond of x, y is the square root of eight x squared plus y squared. Given: a is bigger than zero. Diamond of diamond of a, a, and a, over diamond of a, and diamond of a, a, is equal to what?
Unknowns this time. [short pause] We'll solve it two ways, the full math, and then plugging in numbers.
[short pause] Four diamonds, but diamond of a, a is on top and at the bottom, so three calculations. The inner one, the root of eight a squared plus a squared, the root of nine a squared, three a.
Top, three a goes in the first slot. Three a squared is nine a squared, times eight, seventy-two a squared, plus a squared. a root seventy-three.
Bottom, now three a is in the second slot. Eight a squared plus nine a squared. a root seventeen.
The a's cancel. Root seventy-three over root seventeen, one root of seventy-three seventeenths. Choice number three is our answer.
at: Choice number three is our answer

slides.say: [pause] Another way, and here it's the recommended one. What's different? No letters at all. The choices are plain numbers, so one plug-in is enough. a is positive, take one. Diamond of one, one is the root of nine, three.

Top, diamond of three, one. Three is in the first slot, eight times nine is seventy-two, and seventy-two plus one is seventy-three, so root seventy-three. Some students stop here, only choice number three has seventy-three on top. Bottom, diamond of one, three. Eight plus nine, root seventeen. Choice number three. With unknowns in an operation, plugging in is the way. [pause] Okay. I'll see you in the next question.
